name: Horizontal Flip Gallery
description: Full-screen horizontal gallery of staggered square images. Clicking one flips it into a centered frame over a blurred backdrop with split-text titles and side captions, and clicking again returns it.
contents: Horizontally scrolling row of staggered square images
Detail view per item with blurred backdrop, large split title, and left and right caption blocks
Custom circular cursor that turns into a close icon when a detail is open
behavior: Lenis smooth horizontal scrolling inside the gallery wrapper
Click flips the image to the center using GSAP Flip while other images wipe away
Title characters and caption lines reveal with clip-path and line stagger
Custom cursor follows the mouse with easing and shows on hover over images
editableByProps: Items, images, titles and caption text
Gap, image height, edge padding, detail width, title size and side text width
Flip duration and ease, scroll smoothness, backdrop blur and opacity, cursor size

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the staggered up and down offset of gallery images
needsCodeEdit.where: odd:translate-y-[30%] even:-translate-y-[30%] classes on the gallery wrapper

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the detail text reveal timing

fixed: Fills the viewport (h-screen, full width) and scrolls horizontally with Lenis inside itself
Listens to mousemove on window for the custom cursor, removed on unmount
Uses next/font/google for Space Grotesk and Newsreader
Requires the next package for the font loader
